title: Shopping Inbox
intro: Ten messages about orders and deals. One minute. You did order one thing this week.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Your order #48213 has shipped. Track it in your Meridu account.
cards.why: It matches an order you made, asks for nothing and sends you to your own account.

cards.text: Your parcel is held. Pay €1.20 redelivery: parcelo-pay.help
cards.why: You expected nothing, and it wants a fee through a link.

cards.text: FLASH SALE: all shoes 80% off. Only bank transfer. strideway-outlet-sale.shop
cards.why: A huge discount with a transfer-only payment: a fake shop.

cards.text: You won ₹25,00,000! Pay ₹4,999 tax to claim: lakshmi-prizeclaim.in
cards.why: A prize you never entered, and a fee to collect it.

cards.text: Your order has been delivered. Rate your lamp in your Meridu account.
cards.why: It confirms an order you made and asks only for a rating in your own account.

cards.text: You earned £4.20 cashback. It shows in the Orrin app under Rewards.
cards.why: It asks for nothing and sends you to your own app.

cards.text: You won a free phone! Pay ₹499 delivery: kiko-phones-claim.live
cards.why: A free prize that costs money, from a copy account.

cards.text: Last chance! Your cart is waiting: a desk lamp, still in your basket.
cards.why: A cart reminder asks for nothing. You can ignore it or look in your own account.

cards.text: You owe $4.60 in tolls. Pay now: tarvo-tollpay.live/pay
cards.why: A fee demanded through a link, out of the blue.

cards.text: Your account is suspended! Log in within 1 hour: meridu-login-help.com
cards.why: A threat, a deadline and a look-alike link.

golden_rule: Check any order or prize on the shop's own site, never through a message. Real orders match something you did.

quick_check.q: You get a message about an order you did not make, with a link to pay a fee. What do you do?

options.text: Do not click. Check the shop's own site, and report the message
Call the number in the message

quick_check.explain: A message about something you did not order is the first thing to doubt.
